title: In which months of fiscal 2028 a county 911 center's Friday and Saturday late shift falls short of answering 90 per cent of calls within 15 seconds with four call-takers
subdomain: municipal-service-demand-resource-allocation (a county 911 center's call-taker staffing for its Friday and Saturday late shift against its call-answering standard, fiscal 2028)
prompt_shape: a forecast across the twelve months of fiscal 2028 (each month's expected compliance to the whole per cent and the months below 90 per cent), a chart of the months against the standard, and two tables (Halvorsen Township's wireless calls reaching the agency and transferred to Wexley, by fiscal 2026 quarter; the share of abandoned calls dialled back within two minutes, January to June 2026)

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task148/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional county 911 agency, its regional board, a neighbouring county and a township, in the layouts of a PSAP's ACD and NG911 i3 exports, a scheduling roster, a call-handling system's location records, county GIS and a callback module; no real organisation's records, person or caller is depicted, and every callback number is a pseudonym.
